def solve(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    vals=sorted({x for r in g for x in r})
    cnt={v:sum(r.count(v) for r in g) for v in vals}
    bg=min(vals,key=lambda v: cnt[v])
    out=[]
    for i in range(h):
        row=[]
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=bg: row.append(g[i][j]); continue
            L=(j>0 and g[i][j-1]==5)
            R=(j<w-1 and g[i][j+1]==5)
            U=(i>0 and g[i-1][j]==5)
            D=(i<h-1 and g[i+1][j]==5)
            row.append(4 if ((L and R) or (U and D)) else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
